name: OT Lab - OpenPLC administrative web action
description: HTTP request to the OpenPLC runtime's program upload, compile, start/stop, or user management endpoints. Program changes should only happen from the EWS during an approved change window.
query: destination.ip: "__NET__.40.10" and destination.port: 8080 and url.original: (*upload-program* or *compile-program* or *stop_plc* or *start_plc* or *users* or *settings*)
